# Zeyks Book

Zeyks Book is web-based double-entry accounting software for small businesses in
Nepal — kirana and pasal shops, service businesses, and small agencies. It records
sales, purchases, expenses and settlements in NPR on a real double-entry ledger,
works in both Bikram Sambat (BS) and Gregorian (AD) dates, and prints A4 financial
reports. It runs in the browser at https://www.zeyksbook.app with no desktop
install and no per-seat charges.

> Double-entry bookkeeping for Nepali businesses: BS and AD dates, NPR amounts,
> VAT-aware reports, inventory, and printable A4 statements. Two monthly plans —
> Starter NPR 399 and Premium NPR 599.

## What it does

- Double-entry journal behind every document, so a sale, purchase, expense or
  payment posts balanced debit and credit lines automatically.
- Chart of accounts seeded per business, with sales, purchases and expenses
  mapped to it.
- Sales invoices and purchase bills with document numbers and credit terms, and
  partial or full settlements against either.
- Expense tracking with categories, and VAT handling on sales and purchases.
- Inventory on the Premium plan: items, stock adjustments, valuation, low-stock
  alerts.
- Reports: trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged receivables and
  payables (30/60/90 days), VAT summary, all printable on A4.
- Data health checks that flag unbalanced or orphaned ledger entries.
- Fiscal-year and currency settings, business branding for printed documents.
- Read-only offline view of the last synced books; the server stays the authority.

## Plans and pricing

| Plan | Price | Role value | Unlocks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free account | NPR 0 | `user` | Sign-in only. Every bookkeeping section is locked; nothing can be added or edited. |
| Starter | NPR 399 / month | `plus` | Dashboard, sales, purchases, expenses, settings, JSON backup. |
| Premium | NPR 599 / month | `premium` | Everything in Starter plus payments and settlements, reports, data health, and inventory. |

Billed monthly. No per-seat charges, no usage-based pricing. Changing plans takes
effect on the next page load.

## Access and accounts

- Accounts are created by the Zeyks Book team. There is no self-service sign-up
  form, and no Google or other social sign-in.
- Sign-in is email and password. Ask the team to create an account for your
  business; a demo account is not required to browse the public pages.
- There is no password-recovery flow yet — a forgotten password means contacting
  the team.
- The interactive demo at /demo needs no account at all and never leaves the
  browser.

## Data and privacy

- Business records live in a managed Neon Postgres database, not in the
  customer's own cloud account.
- Sign-in is handled by Neon Auth.
- Every account sees only the businesses it owns or is a member of; access is
  enforced in the database, not just in the app.
- You can download a full JSON snapshot of your books from Settings.
- Restoring a backup is not available yet, and automatic backup/recovery
  commitments are not published.

## What Zeyks Book does not claim

- It is not published as IRD-approved or IRD-verified software. VAT reports and
  A4 statements are product features, not proof of government approval. Confirm
  compliance requirements with the IRD or your accountant.
- Trial terms and a refund policy are not currently published. Confirm the
  current subscription terms before paying.
- Online checkout is not wired up. Plan purchases and upgrades are arranged by
  contacting the team.
